news.title: OpenAI 推出照护者日常 AI 使用培训
news.body: 工作坊介绍照护日程、资源检索和通俗资料整理等用途，并强调隐私及专业咨询边界。公告描述支持计划，实际帮助效果需随实施评估。
news.title_original: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
news.body_original: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.

news.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
news.body: Manage your business information, get insights about how your business shows up, and turn interest into action in ChatGPT.

news.title: 教育合作报告讨论如何补齐 AI 使用指导
news.body: 文章总结欧洲、中东和非洲教育合作中的教师准备、AI 素养及地方支持经验。调查与国家案例有各自范围，不能直接推断普遍学习收益。
news.title_original: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
news.body_original: New ThinkYoung research and lessons from OpenAI’s EMEA education partnerships on supporting teachers, AI literacy, and independent learning.

news.title: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
news.body: New research from OpenAI and Upwork finds shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects.

news.title: MIT 团队获资助研发新一代除草方案
news.body: ARPA-H 项目支持团队探索兼顾农业需求与健康保护的除草替代方案。报道描述研发目标与资金安排，产品效果及安全性仍需后续验证。
news.title_original: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers
news.body_original: With up to $53 million from ARPA-H, the researchers will use AI to generate safer herbicides that reduce dependence on imports and improve the security of the U.S. food supply.

news.title: Pay for Hugging Face Hub with your Google Cloud Account
Language Explorer 展示全球语言多样性
news.body: Google 介绍通过可视化和数据探索世界语言的在线工具，并讨论与语言社区合作的重要性。资料覆盖与产品支持范围需按具体语言核查。
news.title_original: Exploring the world's languages with Language Explorer

news.title: ChatGPT Enterprise 扩展 AWS Marketplace 采购渠道
news.body: 企业可通过 AWS 账户购买并管理相关软件支出。公告介绍采购安排，具体合同、服务可用性和资格仍需按客户条件确认。
news.title_original: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
news.body_original: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

news.title: NVIDIA 与 Elith 发布日本金融场景合成人物数据
news.body: 数据结合官方人口统计、家庭金融与金融素养信息生成合成人物，用于金融 AI 场景研究。合成样本仍需检验分布偏差及具体任务适用性。
news.title_original: Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan: A Synthetic Dataset Capturing Japan's Demographics and Financial Context

news.title: Control Room 集中追踪与停止研究模型任务
news.body: OpenAI 介绍已部署的研究基础设施控制系统，连接推理任务和引擎以响应安全干预。公告中的停止时延与覆盖范围对应其内部实现。
news.title_original: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
news.body_original: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

news.title: HOPE 在专家剪枝中考虑协作关系
news.body: 文章讨论混合专家模型推理时的显存占用，并提出在剪枝时考虑专家之间的联合贡献。效果依赖校准数据和模型结构，压缩后的任务表现需单独评估。
news.title_original: Your Experts Have Partners. There's HOPE for Keeping Them Together

news.title: CodeRabbit 分享智能体开发与代码审核实践
news.body: 案例介绍借助模型、Codex 和 Daybreak 扩展软件开发并审查生成代码。产出提升为企业自报，实际效果依赖团队与项目条件。
news.title_original: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
news.body_original: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

news.title: Kuken 用 AI 检索多年工程图纸
news.body: 案例介绍通过零件号或截图寻找替换部件原始图纸，企业报告检索时间缩短。预计年度节时和已观察检索表现需区分。
news.title_original: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
news.body_original: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

news.title: WorldParticle 用统一架构模拟多类物理过程
news.body: MIT、UBC 等团队介绍将不同物理现象纳入单一深度学习系统的方法，涵盖颗粒、流体及分子等场景。跨现象建模能力仍需按具体体系与耦合条件验证。
news.title_original: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins
news.body_original: By learning how matter moves, the WorldParticle system could assist with developing soft robots, medicines, and more.

papers.title: SHAP 与 SISSO 解释杂化钙钛矿性质预测
papers.body: arXiv:2611.09944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate and interpretable property prediction is essential for exploring hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites. Here, we combine machine-learning screening with SHAP analysis and SISSO descriptor discovery. Using 4,456 compounds, optimized XGBoost models achieved test-set $R^2$ values of 0.99 for formation energy and 0.93 for band gap and were applied to over 180,000 candidates. Comparison across approximately 17,000 common compounds revealed broadly overlapping distributions from XGBoost and CGCNN but substantially lower predictions from UPET, suggesting potential limitations in its transferability to hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites.
